title: Common to Whom? Regional Cultural Commonsense and LLM Bias in India

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating implicit regional preferences using Region-Agnostic Multiple Choice Questions (RA-MCQ), where models select among unnamed regional cultural practices. A chi-square goodness-of-fit test is then used to measure the over-selection or under-selection of specific geographic regions (e.g., North, South, East, West, Central India) as the default representation of the nation.

Assessing models' generation of region-specific cultural commonsense knowledge using Region-Anchored Short Answer (RASA) tasks and identifying monolithic cultural assumptions by observing which sub-national cultural practices models default to when geographic context is removed.
